note: Family and labour law are the entities' own. Majority: the Family Law of the Federation of BiH (Porodični zakon FBiH, Sl. novine FBiH 35/2005 as amended), article 157: capacity by majority or by marriage before it; a person of 18 is of age. The Republika Srpska's Family Law (Sl. glasnik RS 17/2023), article 94(3), gives full capacity on reaching majority or a court-allowed marriage; its age wasn't found in the text read, and no entity is known to set another, so no regions are held (Brčko District's law wasn't read). Work: the FBiH Labour Law (Zakon o radu, Sl. novine FBiH 26/2016), article 20: no employment contract, and no work of any kind, with a person under fifteen; 15 to 18 with the legal representative's consent and a health finding. The RS Labour Law (Sl. glasnik RS 1/2016 as amended to 59/2026), article 26: employment from at least fifteen; article 27: under 18 only with written parental consent and a health finding. Neither makes an exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below fifteen (my reading). Service: conscription in BiH ended with the state Defence Law of 2005, but no law or Ministry of Defence page saying so was read (mod.gov.ba returned a page with no text); left null. Texts read from Paragraf.ba's free consolidated texts (a private legal publisher).
